title: UPI for shops: accept payments the safe way
summary: Why shops use UPI, and how to keep your records and your money safe.

sections.heading: UPI is widely used
paragraphs: The box above shows how many UPI payments were made in a recent month, from NPCI data.

sections.heading: Why shops accept UPI
paragraphs: Customers can pay by scanning your QR code with their phone. The money goes to your bank account.

sections.heading: Record every payment
paragraphs: When a customer pays an udhar by UPI, note it in your khata so the balance stays right.

sections.heading: Stay safe
paragraphs: Check that the money has reached your account before you hand over the goods. Never share your UPI PIN with anyone.
